dossier.scp_unleashed.096.title: The "Shy Guy"
dossier.scp_unleashed.096.caption: SCP-096. The original image has been destroyed and this copy redacted.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-096 is to be held in a sealed steel cell with no windows. **No camera, window or viewing port may give a line of sight to its face.** The cell is monitored by sound and pressure sensors only.
Staff assigned to SCP-096 are issued Scramble Goggles. %rA hood fitted over its head has been effective during transfers.%r
No attempt is to be made to harm SCP-096.
Any image of SCP-096's face, in any medium, is to be destroyed on discovery.
If SCP-096 becomes distressed, all staff are to leave the area and report at once whether they have seen its face.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-096 is a humanoid creature roughly 3.2 metres tall, with very little body mass and pale, hairless skin. Its arms are far too long and hang almost to the ground. Its mouth hangs open in a long, dark slit that stretches further when it is upset, and its eyes are pale and blank.
Left undisturbed, SCP-096 is docile. It wanders without apparent purpose and spends long periods sitting and weeping.

When anyone views its face, directly, through a camera or in a photograph, SCP-096 falls into severe distress. It collapses, clutches its face and wails for several seconds, then screams and runs toward whoever looked.

In this state SCP-096 drops onto all fours and is extremely fast. Walls, doors, floors, ceilings and open water do not stop it, and no injury has slowed it for more than a moment. It does not stop until everyone who saw its face is dead. %rAfterwards, it sits down and weeps.%r

page.title: Addendum 096-1: Recovery
page.text: SCP-096 has no recovery site on record. It was first observed on the night after a reader finished this file, standing in an unlit place nearby with its back turned. %rThe reader did not look closer.%r

page.title: Addendum 096-2: Images
text: SCP-096 has reacted to images of its face only a few pixels across. Distance is no protection; neither is time.
The photograph in this file was redacted after the original was examined under magnification. %rThe examiner was not recovered.%r

item.scp_unleashed.scp096_bag.tooltip: A coarse drawstring hood, cut for a very long head.
item.scp_unleashed.scp096_bag.tooltip.de: It only goes on with the wearer's cooperation. Get close, and keep your eyes low.
item.scp_unleashed.scramble_goggles.tool: Optics that refuse to show you one particular thing.
Anything the lenses recognise is buried under black static before it reaches your eyes.
They cannot undo what you have already seen.
death.attack.scp_unleashed.scp096_caught: %1$s saw the face of %2$s while fighting %3$s
message.scp_unleashed.scp096.refuses: The controller finds nothing behind those eyes it can hold on to
SCP-096, "the Shy Guy": an extremely tall, emaciated, pale humanoid with very long arms. Euclid-class.
Left alone, it is docile. It wanders aimlessly and often stops to sit and weep.
Anyone who views its face, by any means, or who wounds it, sends it into extreme distress. It will then hunt that person down and kill them.
Once enraged, it is far faster than any runner and breaks through walls, floors and ceilings to reach its target. No wound has ever stopped it for more than a moment.
It does not occur naturally. It has been found near a reader, in the dark, on the night after its file was opened.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp096_bag.1: A coarse drawstring hood large enough for SCP-096's head.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp096_bag.2: A hooded subject's face cannot be seen. It will not stay on through an episode.
Facility eyewear issued to staff who work near SCP-096. Worn on the head.
The lenses smother certain images under black static before they reach the wearer.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp096.spawn.fail: There is no room for SCP-096 there.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp096.enrage: SCP-096 has been seen. It now has %s target(s).
commands.scp_unleashed.scp096.calm: SCP-096 settles. Its targets are forgotten.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp096.targets.ab: %s… (not in this dimension, or not loaded)
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp096.0: Expect it near the reader, the night after.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp096.1: It waits somewhere unlit. Do not seek it out.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp096.2: Do not look at its face.
